description: This script analyzes Vitest test report data to identify the top test files by duration, and provides command-line options for report configuration and output formatting.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to Vitest report configuration and options.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest JSON report based on provided arguments and options.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Collects and sorts file duration data from a Vitest report.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string.
